claim: How many hard shadow bands a drawing carries, which is the structural difference between anime and photography. flat_0 reads graphic and cheap, cel_2 is the industry default, painterly abandons cel logic entirely.
method: identical subject sentence and seed in every panel; only the option clause changes. panels marked control render the untouched subject, because SDXL cannot express absence.

panels.clause: cel shading, three tone shading, layered shadows

review.issue: cel_1, cel_2 and cel_3 differ only by a shadow-band count ("single shadow tone" / "two tone shadows" / "three tone shading"). Animagine cannot count shadow bands; all three will land on ordinary two-tone cel shading. Three of six panels identical.
review.fix: Describe the visual consequence instead of the count, or collapse the middle: cel_1 -> "cel shading, single hard shadow, high contrast shading", cel_2 -> "cel shading" (declared default), cel_3 -> "layered shadows, detailed shading, dark rim shadow". If they still converge, drop cel_3.

look_at: flat_0 and painterly bracket the ladder; cel_1/2/3 are indistinguishable.
